name: Puttu and Kadala Curry
instructions: 1. Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure cook until tender. 2. Moisten rice flour with water to a crumbly consistency and layer with grated coconut in a cylindrical steamer (puttu kutti); steam for 5-7 minutes. 3. For the curry, sauté mustard seeds, onions, ginger, garlic, green chilies, and curry leaves in coconut oil. 4. Add turmeric, coriander, and chili powders; sauté until aromatic. 5. Add cooked chickpeas and water/thin coconut milk, simmering until the gravy thickens. 6. Finish with thick coconut milk and a dash of garam masala before serving hot.
description: Puttu and Kadala Curry is the quintessential breakfast of Kerala. It is a harmonious blend of textures—steamed rice cakes and a robust, spice-heavy legume stew—reflecting the state's deep reliance on coconut and locally grown rice as dietary staples.
